sources.name: West Virginia Grown 2025 directory — reviewed capture (EP/MOV/NC/NP)
sources.notes: 164 members hand-parsed from the four downloadable WV Grown 2025 regional PDFs (agriculture.wv.gov). The generic pdf_list adapter under-reads the two-column magazine layout, so the reviewed capture is committed as a seed and re-emitted idempotently. The SW and SE regions ship only as JavaScript flipbooks with no downloadable PDF — not yet captured (needs a browser-rendered pass). Regenerate: python3 run.py --state WV.
